name: Ravion
long_description:
Ravion is the easiest way to use AWS for agents and humans. Get a Vercel-like experience in your own AWS account, with one place to manage and monitor Terraform resources, builds, and deploys.

Use your existing Terraform or start with our standard library of modules. Build and deploy applications, inspect logs and metrics, and customize modules and pipelines as your needs grow.

Your agents get structured configuration, complete CLI and API access, and connected context across infrastructure and deployments. Reviewable plans, permissions, approval gates, and audit history keep your team in control.

You get a production-grade AWS system without assembling every DevOps capability from scratch.

launches.title: Ravion – the easiest way to use AWS for agents and humans

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Ravion is the easiest way to use AWS for agents and humans. Get a Vercel-like experience in your own AWS account, with one place to manage and monitor Terraform resources, builds, and deploys. Use your existing Terraform or start with our standard library of modules, then customize as your needs grow.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114496&key=user_uploads/280296/a5bdea0f-19b9-46f4-8553-35cd76b2c238)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=114496&key=user_uploads/280296/841484c9-539d-4f3d-bb30-6770859a1a03)

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fp5R5v8Uon4>

We launched Flightcontrol during W22 to make AWS as easy as using a PaaS. Over the past five years, Flightcontrol managed millions of AWS compute for thousands of users. Developers loved it, but devops teams needed something they could extend and govern.

Before AI, we were pursuing ease of use and good DX, but that’s less important now. Today when evaluating products, we want the most powerful product in the market that is also agent-friendly.

Ravion is what we built from scratch over the past 13 months for this new world.

**WHAT IT IS**

Ravion is the agent-native cloud infrastructure platform that gives you one system to orchestrate everything in your AWS account.

**Import or provision** new infrastructure, **build** and **deploy** any type of application, and **monitor** logs and metrics, all from one agent-friendly platform.

Use your existing Terraform or start with our standard library of Terraform-backed modules.

**Saves time and tokens** because AI agents get typed module schemas and connected context across infrastructure state, deployments, failures, logs and metrics.

**Enhances safety** by gating infrastructure changes on preview plans and approval gates.

The result is a production-grade AWS DevOps system that you didn’t have to assemble from scratch and is fully customizable as your needs change.

> I love Ravion's agent-friendly structure for getting great defaults on AWS while still being able to customize deployments just the way we need. And their support has been invaluable.” -Edgars Jekabsons, Engineering Manager at Ember

**HOW YOU CAN USE IT**

* **Start fresh:** use our production-ready module library to deploy any type of service in a single prompt
* **Plug and play your existing Terraform:** start with Ravion as an Terraform Cloud or Spacelift alternative, then package existing stacks into governed modules over time.
* **Have existing AWS infra from click-ops?** Import them into Ravion standard modules so they become tracked by infrastructure-as-code and exposed to agents through Ravion.

**KEY FEATURES**

* Deploy web servers, workers, static sites, Lambda function databases, caches, file storage, and more
* Standard modules for ECS, EC2, VPC, load balancers, RDS, Aurora, CloudFront, Lambda, S3, Route53, IAM, ElastiCache, and more
* GitHub action style pipelines that run in your AWS for builds and other CI

Learn more and get started for free at [Ravion.com](https://www.ravion.com?ref=yc)

launches.title: Flightcontrol - Developer-first AWS infrastructure
launches.tagline: Use the best AWS services without tedious infra work
launches.body:
AWS has been too intimidating and tedious, causing teams to settle for a simplistic black-box PaaS or hiring DevOps too early. But no more! 🙅🏼

Our **Developer-first AWS infrastructure** enables you to use the best AWS services without manual infra work. In fact, you might even call it delightful 😍

![](https://www.flightcontrol.dev/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.datocms-assets.com%2F98758%2F1699399752-browser-min.png%3Ffit%3Dcrop%26q%3D90&w=3840&q=75)

**Simple setup**

1️⃣ Connect your GitHub & AWS accounts in 1-click\
2️⃣ Zero config or customize to your heart’s content\
3️⃣ Relax while we deploy to your AWS\
4️⃣ Never worry about hitting the technical or cost limits of black box PaaS

**Deploy every language, globally**

✅ Servers, background workers, static sites, databases, redis. Coming: cron, Lambda and more\
✅ Every language and framework\
✅ Use all 32 AWS regions. Multi-region deploys are in early access

**A few years ago** I was building an app that should have been using native AWS services. I tried, but it was too hard. So I ended up on Vercel with a Frankenstein collection of third-party services. It worked ok until I accidentally racked up a $6,000 bill 😬 That was my fault, but the rickety setup of callbacks and lambda chains made it much easier to fail.

So I thought, why can’t I have a great developer experience on my own AWS account?! Then I met [**@Mina Abadir**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mabadir/) who has been using AWS since S3 & EC2 were all they had. He had the same vision of a better cloud, so we joined forces and the rest is history!

**You can now easily deploy and manage AWS services without having to use AWS console or CLI.** The all-new dashboard has runtime logs, metrics, and even live AWS cost reporting.

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=76674&key=user_uploads/280296/fb138ef1-3f3a-476b-8b35-ed751e7a35cd)

2\.0 barely scratches our vision. But it's now a mature product we're really proud of!

Companies of all sizes from startups to Series H are now using us to deploy thousands of times each month.

**We’re known for providing an exceptional level of support.** So whether you are just starting or have a massive setup to migrate, we’re available to help and make sure everything goes smoothly.

**If you are even a little bit frustrated** with your current infra setup, I invite you to take Flightcontrol for a test flight!

Start a free trial: [**www.Flightcontrol.dev**](https://www.Flightcontrol.dev?ref=launchyc)
